method: Causal 1/3/6/10-GW value functions. Expected tenure is computed from deadline-known availability, role stability, evidence depth, and team stability; low-tenure transfers pay an exit/option cost. Ridge models use prior seasons only and are quantile-mapped to the structural planning scale.

fixedSixWeekDiagnosis.futureScheduleTreatment: Only the current slate is observed in the censored backtest; later slots are neutral.

selectionRule: Choose by the two untouched calibration seasons only. Promotion also requires a higher evaluation average, no lower minimum, and improvement in at least five of eight evaluation seasons. Oracle rows are never eligible.
